## Visitor problem and evidence
Describe the actual recruiter/client/mobile task being improved and link to code-level evidence. Never invent analytics.

## Owner-approved scope / acceptance criteria
- [ ] Scope and observable pass/fail criteria are recorded
- [ ] Owner approved this improvement before implementation

## Implementation and QA
- [ ] npm ci and npm run build completed (or explain why not)
- [ ] ESLint checked changed JS/JSX (or explain why not)
- [ ] 360px, 768px and desktop checked (or marked NOT TESTED)
- [ ] Keyboard, focus, light/dark themes, reduced motion checked (or NOT TESTED)
- [ ] Links, navigation and contact flow checked (or NOT TESTED)
- [ ] No secrets, fictional portfolio claims or unrelated dependencies
- [ ] README updated for meaningful changes (or explain why no documentation change was needed)

## Reviewer findings / untested items
Document outcomes and known limitations.

**Human approval required** before merge and deployment.
